name: AI Agents Made Simple
text:
AI Agents Made Simple

In this talk, we will explore the capabilities of AI agents and how to use them effectively with LangChain.

name: AI in the Browser: Am I Still Waiting for It?
text:
AI in the Browser: Am I Still Waiting for It?

In this talk, we will explore the current state of AI in the browser and discuss whether we are truly leveraging its potential or still waiting for it to fully materialize.

name: ChromeDevTools—are you confident in your expertise?
text:
ChromeDevTools—are you confident in your expertise?

In this talk, we will explore the capabilities of ChromeDevTools and how they can enhance our development workflow.We'll discuss the importance of mastering these tools to improve debugging, performance optimization, and overall productivity.

name: Chrome DevTools, for super fast SSR applications!
text:
Chrome DevTools, for super fast SSR applications!

In this talk, we will explore the capabilities of ChromeDevTools and how use them to optimize the performance of server-side rendered (SSR) applications.We will cover techniques for accessibility and performance debugging and improvements.

name: Costruiamo agenti con ADK-js
text:
Costruiamo agenti con ADK-js

In questo workshop, esploreremo le basi e le potenzialità di ADK-js per costruire agenti intelligenti.

name: Don't Trust Your Types: Type Testing with TSTyche
text:
Don't Trust Your Types: Type Testing with TSTyche

TypeScript can make a Fastify package feel safe while a small refactor silently erases its public contract. This talk introduces type testing with TSTyche and shows how to protect route inference, invalid usage, and TypeScript-version compatibility.

name: React Compiler, how can you help me?
text:
React Compiler, how can you help me?

In this talk, we will explore the capabilities of the React Compiler and how it can enhance our development workflow.

name: Vibe Coding: Let’s Follow the Flow
text:
Vibe Coding: Let’s Follow the Flow

In this talk, we will explore the concept of 'vibe coding' and how it can enhance our development process. We'll discuss the importance of maintaining a positive and collaborative atmosphere within our teams, and how this can lead to more effective problem-solving and innovation.
